passages.title: 科學博物館的恐龍
passages.text: Last Saturday, our class visited the science {1} in Taichung. The biggest room had a real dinosaur skeleton. It was twelve meters long and taller than a two-story house. Our guide {2} at its huge teeth. "This dinosaur ate meat," she said. "When it was alive, it was as {3} as three elephants." Then she took us into a dark room. Suddenly, we heard a loud, deep sound, and a few girls screamed. "Don't worry," the guide laughed. "Scientists used computers to make the dinosaur's {4}. Nobody really knows what it sounded like." We also touched a real dinosaur egg and dug for fake bones in a big sandbox. At the {5} of the trip, I bought a small dinosaur toy at the gift shop. Now it stands on my desk and watches me do my homework.

blanks.why: science museum「科學博物館」，後面說有恐龍骨骼。office（辦公室）、distance（距離）、voice（聲音）都不是參觀恐龍的地方。
point at …「指著…」：導覽員指著牠巨大的牙齒。covered（覆蓋）、passed（經過、傳遞）、married（結婚）接 at 都不通。
as heavy as …「和…一樣重」：跟三頭大象一樣重。serious、late、early 都不能拿來和大象比。
the dinosaur's voice「恐龍的聲音」，前面說聽到低沉的聲響。letter（信）、office、distance 都不能「用電腦做出來」當作叫聲。
at the end of the trip「這趟旅程最後」。power、size、space 不能接 at the ___ of the trip。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們班去參觀台中的科學博物館。最大的展廳裡有一副真的恐龍骨骼，長十二公尺，比兩層樓的房子還高。導覽員指著牠巨大的牙齒說：「這隻恐龍吃肉。牠活著的時候，跟三頭大象一樣重。」接著她帶我們走進一間暗暗的房間。突然，我們聽到一個又大又低沉的聲音，有幾個女生尖叫起來。「別擔心，」導覽員笑著說，「這是科學家用電腦做出來的恐龍叫聲，沒有人真的知道牠的聲音是什麼樣子。」我們還摸了真正的恐龍蛋，在大沙坑裡挖假的骨頭。旅程最後，我在禮品店買了一隻小恐龍玩具。現在它站在我書桌上，看著我寫功課。

passages.title: 阿公的手寫信
passages.text: My grandpa lives in Hualien, far from our home in Taipei. He doesn't use a smartphone, so he writes me a {1} every month. His handwriting is big and a little hard to read, but his letters always {2} two whole pages. He tells me about his farm, his dog, and the weather. Last month, his letter came with a {3} box of oranges from his farm. It was so big that my dad had to help me carry it inside. After I read the letter, I really wanted to hear his {4}, so I called him. He was very happy and laughed a lot. "Even with a long {5} between us, I feel close to you when I read your letters," he said. Now I write back to him every month, too. I always put a drawing in the envelope.

blanks.why: write + 人 + a letter「寫信給某人」，後面說 his letters。voice、museum、distance 都不能「寫」。
cover two pages「寫滿兩整頁」，cover 有「布滿、佔滿」的意思。point（指）、pass（傳遞）、fire（開火）接 two whole pages 都不通。
a heavy box「很重的箱子」，後面說爸爸要幫忙搬。serious、late、early 都不能形容箱子重。
hear his voice「聽到他的聲音」，所以打電話給他。letter、office、museum 都不能「聽」。
a long distance「很長的距離」：即使我們相隔很遠。voice、office、museum 都不能表示兩地之間的距離。

passages.zh: 我的阿公住在花蓮，離我們台北的家很遠。他不用智慧型手機，所以每個月都寫一封信給我。他的字很大，有點難讀，但他的信總是寫滿兩整頁。他會跟我說他的農場、他的狗和天氣。上個月，他的信和一箱從農場寄來的柳丁一起到了。箱子很重，爸爸還得幫我搬進屋裡。讀完信後，我好想聽聽他的聲音，就打電話給他。他很開心，笑個不停。「雖然我們離得很遠，但讀你的信時，我覺得你就在身邊。」他說。現在我每個月也回信給他，而且總會在信封裡放一張我畫的圖。

passages.title: 參觀消防隊
passages.text: Last week, our class visited the fire station near our school. A firefighter, Mr. Huang, showed us his uniform and helmet. "My clothes are very {1}," he said. "They weigh about twenty kilos." Some of us tried to lift them, but we could not. "When there is a {2}, we must be ready to go in sixty seconds," he told us. Then he let us hold the water hose. The water came out so fast and so {3} that two boys almost fell down. Mr. Huang also taught us what to do if our clothes catch fire: "Stop, drop, and roll. And {4} your face with your hands." We all practiced on the grass. At the {5} of the visit, each of us got a small red fire truck as a gift. I put mine next to my bed to remind me to stay safe.

blanks.why: heavy「重的」，後面說衣服約二十公斤、我們抬不起來。early、late、serious 都不能形容衣服重。
When there is a fire「有火災時」。voice（聲音）、letter（信）、museum（博物館）都不會讓消防員六十秒內出動。
so strong「那麼強」：水柱強到差點把男生沖倒。late、early、half 都不能形容水柱的力道。
cover your face with your hands「用手遮住臉」。pass、point、fire 接 your face with your hands 都不通。
at the end of the visit「參觀最後」。power、size、space 不能接 at the ___ of the visit。

passages.zh: 上週，我們班參觀了學校附近的消防隊。消防員黃先生給我們看他的制服和頭盔。「我的衣服很重，」他說，「大約有二十公斤。」我們有人試著抬起來，但都抬不動。「發生火災時，我們必須在六十秒內準備好出發。」他告訴我們。接著他讓我們握水管，水噴得又快又強，兩個男生差點跌倒。黃先生也教我們衣服著火時該怎麼做：「停下、趴下、打滾，並用手遮住臉。」我們都在草地上練習了一遍。參觀最後，每個人都拿到一台紅色小消防車當禮物。我把它放在床邊，提醒自己要注意安全。

passages.title: 合唱團男生的變聲期
passages.text: Leo has sung in the school choir for three years. He has a beautiful high {1}, and he always sings the first part. But this year, something strange happened. During practice, his voice suddenly cracked in the middle of a song, and everyone turned to look at him. Leo's face turned red. He wanted to {2} his face and run away. After practice, Ms. Lin talked to him. "Don't worry. Every boy goes through this. It will {3}," she said. "Your voice is changing, and that is not a {4} problem. It just means you are growing up." She moved Leo to the low part. At first, it felt strange, but soon he loved it. At the school concert, Ms. Lin told the choir, "Remember, the {5} is to sing with your heart, not to sing high." Leo smiled and sang his best.

blanks.why: a high voice「高音的嗓音」。letter、office、distance 都不能用 high 形容後拿來唱歌。
cover his face「遮住臉」：他很丟臉，想遮住臉跑走。pass、point、fire 接 his face 都不合語意。
It will pass.「這會過去的。」pass 有「（時間、狀況）過去」的意思。cover、point、fire 單獨放在 will 後面都不通。
a serious problem「嚴重的問題」：變聲不是嚴重的問題。strong、early、half 不能形容 problem。
The point is to …「重點是…」。letter、museum、office 放在 The ___ is to sing … 都不通。

passages.zh: Leo 在學校合唱團唱了三年，他有一副漂亮的高音嗓子，總是唱第一部。但今年發生了一件怪事：練唱時，他的聲音在歌唱到一半突然破音，大家都轉頭看他。Leo 的臉紅了，好想遮住臉逃走。練習結束後，林老師找他談：「別擔心，每個男生都會經歷這個階段，會過去的。你的聲音正在改變，這不是什麼嚴重的問題，只代表你正在長大。」她把 Leo 調到低音部。一開始他覺得很不習慣，但很快就愛上了。在學校音樂會上，林老師對合唱團說：「記住，重點是用心唱，不是唱得高。」Leo 笑了，唱出了他最好的表現。

passages.title: 遠距離的好朋友
passages.text: When I was in sixth grade, my best friend Mia moved to Kaohsiung with her family. The {1} between us was more than three hundred kilometers. At first, we called each other every night. But soon we both became busy with school, and the calls got shorter and shorter. So we decided to write {2} instead, like people in the old days. Every two weeks, I put a long letter and a few stickers in an envelope and {3} it to her. Writing by hand is slow, but I like it. It makes me think carefully about every word. Mia's letters always {4} both sides of the paper, and she draws funny pictures in the corners. Last summer, I finally took the train to visit her. When she saw me at the station, she shouted my name in a loud {5} and ran to hug me.

blanks.why: the distance between us「我們之間的距離」：超過三百公里。voice、office、museum 都不能用公里來量。
write letters「寫信」，後面說把信放進信封。voices、offices、museums 都不能「寫」。
send … to + 人「寄給某人」，send 的過去式 sent。threw（丟）、baked（烤）、married（結婚）都不是寄信的動作。
cover both sides of the paper「寫滿紙的兩面」。pass、point、fire 接 both sides of the paper 都不通。
in a loud voice「大聲地」是固定用法。letter、distance、office 都不能接 in a loud ___。

passages.zh: 我六年級的時候，最好的朋友 Mia 跟著家人搬到高雄。我們之間的距離超過三百公里。一開始，我們每天晚上都講電話，但很快地，我們都忙於課業，電話也越講越短。所以我們決定改成寫信，就像以前的人一樣。每兩個星期，我會把一封長長的信和幾張貼紙放進信封寄給她。用手寫字很慢，但我很喜歡，因為它讓我仔細思考每一個字。Mia 的信總是寫滿紙的兩面，還會在角落畫好笑的圖。去年暑假，我終於搭火車去看她。她在車站一看到我，就大聲喊我的名字，跑過來抱住我。

passages.title: 太重的書包
passages.text: Every morning, my little brother carries a {1} school bag to school. It has seven textbooks, three workbooks, a water bottle, and a lunch box. One day, I {2} it up and was shocked. It weighed almost six kilos! My brother weighs only thirty kilos, and doctors say a school bag should not be more than ten percent of your body weight. His back often hurt. My mom was worried, so she wrote a {3} to his teacher. She asked if students could leave some books at school. The teacher wrote back the next day. "That's a good {4}," she said. "I didn't know the bags were so heavy." The principal's {5} even sent a notice to all parents about it. Now every student has a small locker in the classroom, and my brother walks to school with a smile.

blanks.why: a heavy school bag「很重的書包」，後面列出一大堆東西。late、early、serious 都不能形容書包重。
pick it up「把它拿起來」，pick 的過去式 picked。hid（藏）、baked（烤）、married（結婚）都不能和 up 組成「拿起」。
write a letter to …「寫信給…」。voice、museum、distance 都不能「寫給」老師。
That's a good point.「說得有道理。」point 在這裡是「論點、看法」。distance、office、museum 都不合語意。
the principal's office「校長室」，可以發通知給家長。museum、voice、distance 都不是發通知的單位。

passages.zh: 每天早上，我弟弟都背著很重的書包上學，裡面有七本課本、三本習作、一個水壺和一個便當盒。有一天，我把它拿起來，嚇了一跳：書包快六公斤重！我弟弟才三十公斤，而醫生說書包不應該超過體重的百分之十。他的背常常會痛。媽媽很擔心，就寫了一封信給他的老師，問學生能不能把一些書留在學校。老師隔天就回信了：「您說得很有道理，我不知道書包這麼重。」校長室甚至發了通知給所有家長。現在每個學生在教室裡都有一個小置物櫃，弟弟每天都笑著走路上學。

passages.title: 跟媽媽去上班
passages.text: Last Friday was "Bring Your Child to Work Day," so I went to my mom's {1}. It is on the twentieth floor of a tall building in Taipei. From the window, I could see Taipei 101 in the {2}. My mom works in a team of eight people. In the morning, they had a meeting, and everyone spoke in quiet, serious {3}. My job was to {4} papers to everyone at the table. Then I helped my mom check some numbers on her computer. At first, her work looked {5}, but it was not. She answered thirty emails, made ten phone calls, and had two more meetings. By five o'clock, I was so tired. On the way home, I said, "Mom, your job is harder than school!" She laughed and bought me a bubble tea.

blanks.why: my mom's office「媽媽的辦公室」，後面說在大樓二十樓。letter、voice、distance 都不能是「去」的地點。
in the distance「在遠方」：從窗戶可以看到遠方的 101。voice、letter、office 不能接 in the ___ 表示遠方。
speak in quiet voices「小聲地說話」。letters、offices、museums 都不能接 spoke in quiet ___。
pass papers to …「把文件傳給…」。cover、point、fire 接 papers to everyone 都不通。
look easy「看起來簡單」，後面說 but it was not（但其實不是）。dead、past 不能形容工作；own 不能單獨放在 looked 後面。

passages.zh: 上星期五是「帶孩子上班日」，所以我去了媽媽的辦公室。它在台北一棟高樓的二十樓，從窗戶可以看到遠方的台北 101。媽媽的團隊有八個人。早上他們開會，大家都用小聲又嚴肅的語氣說話。我的工作是把文件傳給桌邊的每一個人。接著我幫媽媽在電腦上檢查一些數字。一開始她的工作看起來很簡單，但其實不是。她回了三十封電子郵件、打了十通電話，還開了兩場會。到了五點，我已經累壞了。回家路上，我說：「媽，你的工作比上學還難！」她笑了，買了一杯珍珠奶茶給我。

passages.title: 最後十秒的三分球
passages.text: Our school basketball team was in the final game, and we were losing by one {1}. There were only ten seconds left. The coach called a timeout. "Ken, {2} the ball to Leo," he said. "He will take the last shot." But when the game started again, two tall players stood in front of Leo. Everyone in the gym was shouting in loud {3}. Ken had no choice. With three seconds left, he shot the ball from a long {4}, far behind the three-point line. The ball flew high into the air. The gym was suddenly quiet. Then... it went in! Three {5}! The buzzer rang, and we won by two. All of us ran onto the court and jumped on Ken. "I didn't follow the plan," he said, laughing. The coach laughed, too. "That's OK this time!"

blanks.why: lose by one point「落後一分」。letter、voice、museum 都不能用來算比賽分數。
pass the ball to …「把球傳給…」。cover、marry、bake 接 the ball to Leo 都不通。
in loud voices「大聲地」：體育館裡大家都在大喊。letters、offices、museums 都不能接 in loud ___。
from a long distance「從很遠的距離」，後面說在三分線後很遠。voice、letter、office 都不能表示投籃的距離。
three points「三分」：投進三分球。letters、voices、museums 都不能用來算分數。

passages.zh: 我們學校籃球隊打進了決賽，但還落後一分，比賽只剩十秒。教練叫了暫停：「Ken，把球傳給 Leo，讓他投最後一球。」但比賽重新開始時，有兩個高個子球員擋在 Leo 前面，整個體育館的人都在大聲喊叫。Ken 沒有選擇了。剩下三秒時，他在三分線後很遠的地方出手投籃。球高高飛向空中，體育館突然安靜下來。接著……球進了！三分！終場鈴聲響起，我們贏了兩分。我們全部衝進球場撲向 Ken。「我沒照計畫打。」他笑著說。教練也笑了：「這次就算了！」

passages.title: 數學終於及格
passages.text: Hana is not good at math. Last semester, she did not {1} a single math test. She felt terrible, but she decided to change. Every day after school, she went to the teachers' {2} to ask Mr. Lee questions. Mr. Lee was always patient. He {3} out her mistakes kindly and showed her easier ways to solve problems. "Don't be {4} of mistakes," he told her. "They show you what you need to learn." Hana practiced every night, even on weekends. Slowly, math became less difficult. On the final exam, she got 72 points, her best score ever. She ran to the office with her test paper. "Mr. Lee, I passed!" she said in a happy {5}. Mr. Lee smiled and gave her a high five. "You did it yourself," he said.

blanks.why: pass a test「考試及格、通過考試」。cover、point、fire 接 a math test 都不通。
the teachers' office「教師辦公室」：放學後去問老師問題。museum、distance、voice 都不是去找老師的地方。
point out「指出」，過去式 pointed：老師溫和地指出她的錯誤。covered out、baked out、married out 都不是片語。
be scared of …「害怕…」：不要怕犯錯。early、late、half 都不能接 of mistakes 表示害怕。
in a happy voice「用開心的聲音」。letter、museum、distance 都不能接 in a happy ___。

passages.zh: Hana 的數學不好，上學期她的數學考試沒有一次及格。她覺得很糟，但決定要改變。每天放學後，她都去教師辦公室問李老師問題。李老師總是很有耐心，他溫和地指出她的錯誤，並教她更簡單的解題方法。「不要害怕犯錯，」他告訴她，「錯誤會讓你知道自己需要學什麼。」Hana 每天晚上都練習，連週末也是。慢慢地，數學變得沒那麼難了。期末考她考了 72 分，是她有史以來最好的成績。她拿著考卷跑到辦公室，用開心的聲音說：「李老師，我及格了！」李老師笑著跟她擊掌：「是你自己做到的。」

passages.title: 雨天撿到的小貓
passages.text: On a rainy afternoon, I saw a small kitten under a car near my school. It was wet and shaking. I took off my jacket and {1} it to keep it warm. Then I called my mom at her {2}. "Bring it home," she said. "We will take it to the vet tonight." The vet said the kitten was about four weeks old. She was a little sick, but it was nothing {3}. "She needs food and a warm place to sleep," the doctor said. We named her Rainy because she came to us on a rainy day. That was three months ago. Now Rainy is three times as {4} as before, and she loves sleeping on my jacket. Her {5} is very small, but she meows very loudly when she is hungry, especially at five in the morning!

blanks.why: cover「蓋住」：脫下外套蓋住小貓保暖。passed、pointed、fired 接 it to keep it warm 都不通。
call + 人 + at + 地點「打電話到某處找某人」：打到媽媽的辦公室。museum、distance、voice 都不是媽媽上班接電話的地方。
nothing serious「沒什麼大礙、不嚴重」。strong、early、half 放在 nothing 後面都不合語意。
three times as heavy as …「是…的三倍重」：小貓長大了。late、early、easy 都不能形容貓的體重。
her voice is very small「她的聲音很小」，後面說餓的時候叫很大聲。letter、office、distance 都不能「很小但會叫」。

passages.zh: 一個下雨的下午，我在學校附近的一台車底下看到一隻小貓，牠全身濕透、一直發抖。我脫下外套蓋住牠保暖，然後打電話到媽媽的辦公室。「帶牠回家吧，」她說，「我們今晚帶牠去看獸醫。」獸醫說小貓大約四週大，有一點生病，但沒什麼大礙。「牠需要食物和一個溫暖的地方睡覺。」醫生說。因為牠是在雨天來到我們家的，我們就叫牠「雨雨」。那是三個月前的事了。現在雨雨的體重是以前的三倍，最喜歡睡在我的外套上。牠的聲音很小，但肚子餓的時候會叫得很大聲，尤其是在早上五點！

passages.title: 營火晚會烤棉花糖
passages.text: On the second night of our school camp, the teachers made a big {1} in the middle of the field. We sat around it in a circle, and Ms. Chen gave each of us a long stick and a bag of marshmallows. "Keep a safe {2} from the fire," she said. My first marshmallow caught fire and turned black, and everyone laughed. My friend Ben showed me the right way: hold it high and turn it slowly. The second one was soft, sweet, and perfect. After that, we sang songs. Ben has a great {3}, so he sang first, and we all joined in. Later, the night got cold, so I {4} myself with a blanket. Suddenly, a teacher {5} at the sky. "Look! A shooting star!" We all looked up and made a wish. I wished for another camp next year.

blanks.why: make a fire「生火」，後面說圍著它坐、烤棉花糖。letter、voice、office 都不能「生」在操場中間。
keep a safe distance from …「和…保持安全距離」。voice、letter、office 都不能接 from the fire 表示距離。
a great voice「很棒的歌聲」，所以由他先唱。letter、office、museum 都和唱歌無關。
cover oneself with …「用…蓋住自己」：用毯子把自己蓋住。passed、pointed、fired 接 myself with a blanket 都不通。
point at …「指著…」：老師指著天空說有流星。passed at、baked at、married at 都不通。

passages.zh: 學校露營的第二天晚上，老師們在操場中間升起一大堆營火。我們圍成一圈坐下，陳老師給每人一根長棍子和一包棉花糖。「要和火保持安全距離。」她說。我的第一顆棉花糖著火變黑了，大家都笑了。我的朋友 Ben 教我正確的方法：拿高一點，慢慢地轉。第二顆又軟又甜，完美極了。之後我們一起唱歌，Ben 的歌聲很棒，所以由他先唱，大家再一起跟著唱。後來夜晚變冷了，我用毯子把自己蓋住。突然，一位老師指著天空：「看！流星！」我們都抬頭許願。我希望明年還能再來露營。

passages.title: 美術館裡的向日葵
passages.text: Last month, my aunt took me to an art {1} in Taipei to see a special show of Van Gogh's paintings. The most famous one was a painting of sunflowers. Many people stood in front of it and talked about it. "Please keep your {2} down," a guard said to a noisy group. My aunt {3} at the yellow flowers. "Look how thick the paint is," she whispered. "You can almost feel it." I wanted to touch it, but there was a sign that said, "Do not touch," and a sheet of glass {4} the painting. My aunt told me that Van Gogh sold only one or two paintings while he was alive, but he never stopped painting. "So the {5} is to do what you love," she said, "even when nobody claps for you." I will remember those words for a long time.

blanks.why: art museum「美術館」，後面說去看梵谷的畫展。office、distance、voice 都不能接 art 表示看畫的地方。
keep your voice down「說話小聲一點」是固定用法。letter、office、distance 都不能接 keep your ___ down 表示「小聲」。
point at …「指著…」：阿姨指著黃色的花。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。
cover「覆蓋」：一片玻璃蓋住畫作保護它。passed、pointed、fired 接 the painting 都不合語意。
The point is to …「重點是…」。letter、office、museum 放在 The ___ is to do what you love 都不通。

passages.zh: 上個月，阿姨帶我去台北的美術館看梵谷特展。最有名的一幅是向日葵。很多人站在畫前討論。「請小聲一點。」一位警衛對一群很吵的人說。阿姨指著那些黃色的花，小聲地說：「你看顏料有多厚，好像摸得到一樣。」我很想摸摸看，但旁邊有「請勿觸摸」的牌子，畫的前面也蓋著一片玻璃。阿姨告訴我，梵谷活著的時候只賣出一兩幅畫，但他從沒停止作畫。「所以重點是做你喜歡的事，」她說，「就算沒有人為你鼓掌也一樣。」我會記住這句話很久很久。

passages.title: 山上的郵差
passages.text: Mr. Lin is a mailman in a small village in the mountains of Nantou. Every day, he rides his motorcycle a long {1} on narrow mountain roads to bring mail to people. His bag is always {2}, full of letters, newspapers, and packages. Many old people in the village live alone, and some of them can't see well. So Mr. Lin often reads their {3} to them and helps them write back. One day after a typhoon, a big rock {4} the road, and no cars could go through. Mr. Lin parked his motorcycle and walked for two hours with the mail on his back. When he finally arrived, Grandma Wu cried with joy. Her grandson had sent her a photo of his new baby from Japan. Back at the post {5}, everyone called Mr. Lin a hero. He just smiled and said, "It's my job."

blanks.why: ride a long distance「騎很長的距離」。voice、office、letter 都不能接 a long ___ 表示路程。
heavy「重的」，後面說裝滿信、報紙和包裹。late、early、serious 都不能形容袋子重。
read their letters「讀他們的信」，後面說幫忙回信。voices、offices、museums 都不能「讀給人聽」。
cover the road「擋住、蓋住道路」，所以車子過不去。passed、pointed、fired 接 the road 都不能表示被擋住。
post office「郵局」，是郵差回去的地方。museum、voice、distance 不能接 post 組成地點。

passages.zh: 林先生是南投山區一個小村莊的郵差。他每天騎著機車，在狹窄的山路上騎很遠的路，把郵件送給大家。他的郵袋總是很重，裝滿了信、報紙和包裹。村裡很多老人獨居，有些人看不太清楚，所以林先生常常唸信給他們聽，還幫他們回信。有一次颱風過後，一顆大石頭擋住了道路，車子都過不去。林先生把機車停好，背著郵件走了兩個小時。他終於抵達時，吳奶奶高興得哭了，原來她在日本的孫子寄來了新生寶寶的照片。回到郵局，大家都說林先生是英雄。他只是笑著說：「這是我的工作。」

passages.title: 小火龍的尾巴
passages.text: In the Pokémon world, Charmander is a small orange Pokémon with a {1} burning on the end of its tail. If the fire goes out, Charmander will die, so it must stay away from rain and water. When it grows up, it becomes Charmeleon, and then Charizard. Charizard has big wings and can fly a long {2} without resting. It is also very {3}: it weighs about ninety kilos! In the anime, Ash's Charizard did not listen to him at first. It was proud and often turned its back on him. But Ash never gave up. One cold night, when Charizard was hurt, Ash {4} it with his own blanket and stayed with it until morning. After that, Charizard {5} to trust him. They became one of the strongest teams in the Pokémon world.

blanks.why: a fire burning「燃燒的火焰」，後面說火熄滅就會死。letter、voice、museum 都不能「燃燒」。
fly a long distance「飛很遠的距離」。voice、letter、office 都不能接 fly a long ___。
heavy「重的」，後面說大約九十公斤。late、early、serious 都不能形容體重。
cover A with B「用 B 蓋住 A」：用自己的毯子蓋住噴火龍。passed、pointed、fired 接 it with his blanket 都不通。
begin to + 原形動詞「開始…」：噴火龍開始信任他。sent、threw、baked 後面不能接 to trust。

passages.zh: 在寶可夢的世界裡，小火龍是一隻橘色的小寶可夢，尾巴尖端燃燒著一團火。如果火熄了，小火龍就會死，所以牠必須遠離雨和水。牠長大後會變成火恐龍，然後變成噴火龍。噴火龍有一對大翅膀，可以不休息地飛很遠。牠也很重，大約有九十公斤！在動畫裡，小智的噴火龍一開始不聽他的話，牠很驕傲，常常背對著他。但小智從不放棄。一個寒冷的夜晚，噴火龍受了傷，小智用自己的毯子蓋住牠，陪牠到天亮。從那之後，噴火龍開始信任他，他們成了寶可夢世界裡最強的搭檔之一。

passages.title: 不能只看封面
passages.text: Jenny always judges books by their {1}. At the library, she only picks books with pretty pictures on the front. One day, her teacher gave her an old book with a plain brown cover. "This looks boring," Jenny said. "Just read the first ten pages," said the teacher. "If you don't like it, you can {2} it to someone else." That night, Jenny started reading. The story was about a girl who traveled a great {3} across the desert to find her lost father. Jenny could not stop. She read until midnight and finished the whole book on Sunday. On Monday, she wrote a thank-you {4} and put it on her teacher's desk. The teacher read it and smiled. "Now you know," she said. "The {5} is what's inside a book, not what's outside."

blanks.why: judge a book by its cover「以封面判斷一本書」，後面說只挑封面漂亮的書。voices、offices、distances 都不能「放在書的正面」。
pass … to someone else「把…傳給別人」：不喜歡就給別人看。cover、point、fire 接 it to someone else 都不通。
travel a great distance「走很遠的路」。voice、office、letter 都不能接 traveled a great ___。
a thank-you letter「感謝信」，可以放在老師桌上。voice、office、distance 都不能「寫了放在桌上」。
The point is …「重點是…」：重點是書的內容。letter、office、museum 放在這裡都不通。

passages.zh: Jenny 總是以封面來判斷一本書。在圖書館，她只挑正面有漂亮圖片的書。有一天，老師給她一本封面是樸素咖啡色的舊書。「看起來好無聊。」Jenny 說。「先讀前十頁就好，」老師說，「如果不喜歡，可以把它給別人。」那天晚上，Jenny 開始讀。故事講一個女孩橫越沙漠、走了很遠的路去找失蹤的爸爸。Jenny 停不下來，一直讀到半夜，星期天就把整本書讀完了。星期一，她寫了一封感謝信放在老師桌上。老師讀了之後笑著說：「現在你知道了吧，重點是書的內容，不是外表。」

passages.title: 被叫到校長室
passages.text: "Kevin Chen, please come to the principal's {1}." The message came over the school speakers during math class. Everyone turned to look at Kevin. "What did you do?" his friend whispered. "Nothing!" Kevin said. As he walked down the hall, his legs felt {2}, and his heart was beating fast. He knocked on the door. The principal, Mrs. Ho, looked very {3}. "Kevin, did you find a wallet on the playground yesterday?" she asked. "Yes," Kevin said. "I gave it to my teacher." Mrs. Ho smiled for the first time. "The owner is an old man. He {4} us a letter to thank you." Then she read the letter aloud in a warm {5}. At the school meeting the next Monday, Kevin got a prize for being honest. He was not scared of the principal's office anymore.

blanks.why: the principal's office「校長室」。museum、distance、letter 都不能「來到」。
legs feel heavy「腳步沉重」：緊張到腳很沉重。early、late、half 都不能形容腿的感覺。
look serious「看起來很嚴肅」，後面說 smiled for the first time 才第一次笑。early、half、past 都不能形容表情。
send + 人 + a letter「寄信給某人」，過去式 sent。threw、baked、married 接 us a letter 都不通。
in a warm voice「用溫暖的聲音」。letter、office、distance 都不能接 in a warm ___。

passages.zh: 「陳 Kevin，請到校長室。」數學課時，擴音器傳來這段廣播。全班都轉頭看 Kevin。「你做了什麼？」他的朋友小聲問。「什麼都沒有！」Kevin 說。他走在走廊上，腳步沉重，心跳得好快。他敲了敲門，何校長看起來很嚴肅。「Kevin，你昨天是不是在操場撿到一個錢包？」她問。「是的，」Kevin 說，「我交給老師了。」何校長第一次露出笑容：「失主是一位老先生，他寄了一封信來謝謝你。」接著她用溫暖的聲音把信唸出來。下週一的朝會上，Kevin 因為誠實得到了獎狀。他再也不怕校長室了。

passages.title: 第一次跑五公里
passages.text: Last month, my dad and I signed up for a five-kilometer race in the park. I had never run such a long {1} before. We practiced three times a week after dinner. On race day, I was so excited that I started too fast. After two kilometers, my legs felt {2}, and I could hardly breathe. Many people began to {3} me, even an old man with white hair. I wanted to stop and walk. My dad stayed beside me. "Don't think about the finish line," he said. "Just run to the next tree." He {4} at a big tree ahead of us. When we got there, he pointed at another one. Tree by tree, we kept going. At the fourth kilometer, I heard my mom's {5} from the crowd: "Go, go, go!" I ran faster, and we crossed the finish line together.

blanks.why: such a long distance「這麼長的距離」：從沒跑過這麼遠。voice、letter、office 都不能用來說跑步的長度。
legs feel heavy「腿很沉重」：跑兩公里就沒力了。late、early、serious 都不能形容腿的感覺。
pass「超越、從旁邊經過」：很多人開始超過我。cover、point、fire 接 me 都不能表示超越。
point at …「指著…」：爸爸指著前面的大樹。covered、baked、married 接 at 都不通。
hear my mom's voice「聽到媽媽的聲音」，後面就是她喊的話。letter、office、museum 都不能「從人群中聽到」。

passages.zh: 上個月，我和爸爸報名了公園的五公里路跑。我以前從沒跑過這麼遠的距離。我們每週三次在晚餐後練習。比賽當天，我太興奮，一開始跑太快了。跑了兩公里後，我的腿變得好沉重，幾乎喘不過氣。很多人開始超過我，連一位白髮老爺爺都超過我了。我好想停下來用走的。爸爸一直陪在我旁邊。「不要想終點線，」他說，「只要跑到下一棵樹就好。」他指著前面一棵大樹。到了那裡，他又指向另一棵。就這樣一棵樹接一棵樹，我們繼續跑。跑到第四公里時，我聽到媽媽在人群中的聲音：「加油、加油、加油！」我跑得更快，和爸爸一起衝過了終點線。

passages.title: 窗外的白頭翁
passages.text: Every morning at five, a bird sings outside my bedroom window. It has a sweet, clear {1}. But at first, it woke me up too {2}, and I was angry. I wanted to find the bird and tell it to be quiet. One Saturday, I got up and went outside. My grandpa was already in the garden, drinking tea. He smiled and {3} at a small bird in the tree. It had a white head and a green back. "That's a Chinese bulbul," he said. "It sings to tell other birds that this tree is its home." Grandpa told me that birds can hear each other from a long {4}, even across a whole park. After that day, I began to enjoy the bird's song. Now I don't {5} my ears with my pillow anymore. I just listen and smile, and then I go back to sleep.

blanks.why: a sweet, clear voice「甜美清亮的聲音」，鳥在唱歌。letter、office、distance 都不能形容歌聲。
too early「太早」：清晨五點就被吵醒。late 不合五點；serious、strong 不能修飾 woke me up。
point at …「指著…」：阿公指著樹上的小鳥。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。
from a long distance「從很遠的地方」：鳥隔著整個公園都聽得到彼此。voice、letter、office 都不能表示距離。
cover my ears「摀住耳朵」：不再用枕頭摀住耳朵。pass、point、fire 接 my ears with my pillow 都不通。

passages.zh: 每天早上五點，都有一隻鳥在我房間窗外唱歌，牠的聲音甜美又清亮。但一開始，牠太早把我吵醒，我很生氣，想找到那隻鳥叫牠安靜。一個星期六，我起床走到外面。阿公已經在院子裡喝茶了。他笑著指向樹上的一隻小鳥，牠有白色的頭和綠色的背。「那是白頭翁，」他說，「牠唱歌是為了告訴別的鳥，這棵樹是牠的家。」阿公告訴我，鳥可以從很遠的地方聽到彼此，甚至隔著一整座公園。從那天起，我開始喜歡上牠的歌聲。現在我不再用枕頭摀住耳朵了，只是聽著、笑著，然後再睡回去。

passages.title: 搬家的重箱子
passages.text: Last weekend, my family moved to a new apartment. We had forty boxes! One of them was really {1} because it was full of my dad's old books. It was so heavy that two people had to carry it together. The elevator was broken that day, so we had to carry everything up to the fifth floor. My dad and my uncle {2} the boxes to each other up the stairs, one by one. By the {3} of the day, everyone was very tired and hungry. We ate pizza on the floor because the table was not ready yet. "Our new home is twice the {4} of our old one," my mom said happily. Then my dad opened his heavy box. On top of the books, there was a small bundle of old {5}. They were the love letters my mom wrote to him twenty years ago! Mom's face turned red, and we all laughed.

blanks.why: heavy「重的」，因為裝滿了書，後面說重到要兩個人抬。easy、sick、dead 都不能形容箱子。
pass A to B「把 A 傳給 B」：爸爸和叔叔在樓梯上一箱一箱傳遞。covered、pointed、fired 接 the boxes to each other 都不通。
by the end of the day「到那天結束時」。power、size、space 不能接 by the ___ of the day。
twice the size of …「是…的兩倍大」。piece、date、lesson 都不能表示大小。
old letters「舊信」，後面說是媽媽寫的情書。voices、offices、museums 都不能「一小疊」放在箱子裡。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們家搬到一間新公寓。我們有四十個箱子！其中一箱裝滿了爸爸的舊書，非常重，重到要兩個人一起抬。那天電梯剛好壞了，我們只好把所有東西搬上五樓。爸爸和叔叔在樓梯上把箱子一箱一箱傳給對方。到了晚上，大家都又累又餓。因為桌子還沒擺好，我們就坐在地上吃披薩。「新家是舊家的兩倍大。」媽媽開心地說。接著爸爸打開了他那個重箱子，書的最上面有一小疊舊信。原來是二十年前媽媽寫給他的情書！媽媽的臉都紅了，我們全都笑了出來。

passages.title: 遠方的燈塔
passages.text: My grandpa was a fisherman in Penghu for forty years. On dark nights at sea, he always looked for the lighthouse. "When I saw its light in the {1}, I knew I was almost home," he says. One night, a thick fog {2} the sea, and Grandpa could not see the lighthouse at all. His boat was lost, and the waves were getting bigger. Then he heard the {3} of his friend on the radio. His friend was standing at the lighthouse, and he told Grandpa which way to go. Slowly, Grandpa found his way back. "It was the most {4} night of my life," he told me. Last summer, he took me to visit the old lighthouse. We stood at the top, and he {5} at the dark blue sea. "That is where I almost got lost," he said quietly.

blanks.why: in the distance「在遠方」：看到遠方的燈光。voice、letter、office 不能接 in the ___ 表示遠方。
cover「覆蓋」：濃霧覆蓋了海面，所以看不到燈塔。passed、pointed、fired 接 the sea 都不能表示「被霧遮住」。
hear the voice of …「聽到…的聲音」：從無線電聽到朋友的聲音。letter、office、museum 都不能從無線電「聽到」。
the most dangerous「最危險的」：差點迷失在海上。able（能夠的）、past、own 都不能這樣形容那一夜。
point at …「指著…」：阿公指著深藍色的大海。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。

passages.zh: 我阿公在澎湖當了四十年漁夫。在海上的黑夜裡，他總是尋找燈塔。「當我看到遠方的燈光，就知道快到家了。」他說。有一天晚上，濃霧覆蓋了整片海，阿公完全看不見燈塔。他的船迷失了方向，浪也越來越大。這時，他從無線電聽到朋友的聲音。他的朋友站在燈塔上，告訴阿公該往哪裡開。慢慢地，阿公找到了回家的路。「那是我這輩子最危險的一個晚上。」他告訴我。去年夏天，他帶我去參觀那座老燈塔。我們站在最高處，他指著深藍色的大海，輕聲說：「我就是在那裡差點迷路的。」

passages.title: 學校的火災演習
passages.text: Last Wednesday, our school had a fire drill. At ten o'clock, the alarm rang loudly, and we heard an announcement: "This is a drill. There is a {1} in the school kitchen." Our teacher told us to {2} our noses and mouths with wet towels. Then we walked out of the classroom in two lines. We kept our heads low because smoke rises. Nobody was allowed to run or push. "Don't talk," Mr. Wang said in a low {3}. "Just follow the person in front of you." Soon all the classes were on the playground. The principal came out of her {4} with a stopwatch. "Four minutes," she said. "Not bad, but next time it should be three." She also told us, "If there is a real fire, don't go back for your things. Your life is more important than your {5} school bag."

blanks.why: There is a fire「發生火災」，這是火災演習。voice、letter、museum 都不會出現在「廚房發生…」的演習廣播裡。
cover A with B「用 B 摀住 A」：用濕毛巾摀住口鼻。pass、point、fire 接 our noses and mouths 都不通。
in a low voice「小聲地」。letter、office、museum 都不能接 in a low ___。
come out of her office「從她的辦公室走出來」。museum、distance、letter 都不是校長平常待的地方。
a heavy school bag「沉重的書包」。late、early、half 都不能形容書包。

passages.zh: 上星期三，我們學校舉行火災演習。十點時警鈴大響，我們聽到廣播：「這是演習，學校廚房發生火災。」老師要我們用濕毛巾摀住口鼻，然後排成兩排走出教室。因為煙會往上飄，我們都把頭壓低，不准跑也不准推擠。「不要說話，」王老師小聲地說，「跟著前面的人走就好。」很快地，所有班級都到了操場。校長拿著碼錶從辦公室走出來。「四分鐘，」她說，「還不錯，但下次應該要三分鐘。」她也告訴我們：「如果真的發生火災，不要回去拿東西。你的生命比沉重的書包重要多了。」

passages.title: 可可夜總會的歌聲
passages.text: In the movie Coco, Miguel is a twelve-year-old boy in Mexico who loves music. He has a beautiful singing {1}, but his family does not allow any music at home. Long ago, his great-great-grandfather left the family to become a singer. He traveled a long {2} from home and never came back. So the family {3} to hate music. One night, Miguel goes into the Land of the Dead. There he learns the true story: his great-great-grandfather, Héctor, wrote many {4} and songs for his little daughter, Coco. He wanted to go home, but he died before he could. At the {5} of the movie, Miguel goes back and sings "Remember Me" to old Grandma Coco. She smiles and sings along. She remembers her father at last, and the whole family begins to love music again.

blanks.why: a singing voice「歌聲」。letter、office、museum 都不能用 singing 形容。
travel a long distance「走很遠的路」。voice、office、letter 不能接 traveled a long ___。
begin to + 原形動詞「開始…」：家人開始討厭音樂。sent、threw、baked 後面不能接 to hate。
write letters「寫信」：他寫了很多信和歌給女兒。voices、offices、museums 都不能「寫給」女兒。
at the end of the movie「電影最後」。power、size、space 不能接 at the ___ of the movie。

passages.zh: 在電影《可可夜總會》裡，米高是一個住在墨西哥、熱愛音樂的十二歲男孩。他有美妙的歌聲，但家人不准家裡出現任何音樂。很久以前，他的高祖父為了當歌手離開了家，走了很遠的路，從此沒有回來。於是家人開始討厭音樂。一天晚上，米高進入了亡靈之地，在那裡得知了真相：他的高祖父埃克托寫了很多信和歌給年幼的女兒可可。他想回家，卻在回去之前就過世了。電影最後，米高回到人間，對年邁的可可奶奶唱〈請記得我〉。她露出微笑跟著唱，終於想起了自己的父親，全家人也重新愛上了音樂。

passages.title: 博物館裡的木乃伊
passages.text: Last summer, I saw a real mummy at a big {1} in London. The mummy was about three thousand years old. Its whole body was {2} with long pieces of old cloth. Our guide told us that people in ancient Egypt believed the dead needed their bodies in the next life. That was why they made mummies. The mummy lay in a stone box with beautiful pictures on it. The box was so {3} that it took twenty men to move it. A little girl next to me asked her father in a small {4}, "Is it going to wake up?" Everyone around us laughed, even the guide. "Don't worry," he said. "It has been {5} for a very long time. It will not wake up today." The girl did not look sure, and she held her father's hand all the way out.

blanks.why: a big museum「一間大博物館」，後面說看到木乃伊。office、distance、voice 都不是展示木乃伊的地方。
be covered with …「被…覆蓋、包著」：全身用布包著。passed、pointed、fired 接 with long pieces of cloth 都不通。
so heavy that …「重到…」：重到要二十個人才搬得動。late、early、serious 都不能形容石棺重。
in a small voice「小小聲地」。letter、office、distance 都不能接 in a small ___。
have been dead「已經死了（一段時間）」。easy、past、own 都不能接在 has been 後面說明木乃伊的狀態。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我在倫敦一間大博物館看到一具真的木乃伊。它大約有三千年歷史，全身都用一條條舊布包著。導覽員告訴我們，古埃及人相信死者在來世還需要自己的身體，所以才會製作木乃伊。木乃伊躺在一個畫著漂亮圖案的石棺裡，石棺重到要二十個人才搬得動。我旁邊一個小女孩小小聲地問她爸爸：「它會醒過來嗎？」我們周圍的人都笑了，連導覽員也笑了。「別擔心，」他說，「它已經死了很久很久，今天不會醒來的。」小女孩看起來不太相信，一路緊緊牽著爸爸的手走出去。

passages.title: 一眨眼就過去的暑假
passages.text: On the first day of summer vacation, I made a long list of plans: read ten books, learn to swim, and visit the new science {1} in Kaohsiung. Two months seemed like a very long time. But the days {2} so quickly. I played games, slept late, and watched videos all day. Before I knew it, it was the {3} of August. I looked at my list. I had done only one thing on it, and it was not even the books. My mom {4} at the pile of workbooks on my desk. "You haven't finished those either!" she said. So I spent the last week doing homework from morning to night. Now I have learned an important lesson: time {5} fast when you are having fun. Next summer, I will put my list on the wall, and I will start on the first day.

blanks.why: science museum「科學博物館」，是暑假想去參觀的地方。office、voice、distance 都不能接 visit the new science ___。
the days passed「日子過去了」，pass 有「（時間）流逝」的意思。covered、pointed、fired 都不能用 the days 當主詞。
the end of August「八月底」。power、size、space 不能接 the ___ of August 表示月底。
point at …「指著…」：媽媽指著書桌上的一堆習作。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。
time passes「時間流逝」，主詞 time 是單數用 passes。covers、points、fires 都不能用 time 當主詞。

passages.zh: 暑假第一天，我列了一張長長的計畫清單：讀十本書、學會游泳、去參觀高雄新開的科學博物館。兩個月看起來好長，但日子過得好快。我整天打電動、睡懶覺、看影片。不知不覺，已經八月底了。我看著清單，只完成了一件事，而且還不是讀書。媽媽指著我桌上那堆習作：「你連這些也還沒寫完！」所以最後一個星期，我從早到晚都在寫功課。現在我學到一個重要的教訓：快樂的時候，時間過得特別快。明年暑假，我要把清單貼在牆上，而且第一天就開始執行。

passages.title: 指向北方的指南針
passages.text: In the Scouts last month, we learned to use a compass. Its needle always {1} to the north. Our leader took us into the forest and gave each group a map. "Walk to the old camphor tree," she said. "The {2} is about two kilometers." Our group walked for an hour, but we could not find the tree. Our compass was acting strangely. Then we found out why: Leo was holding his phone right next to it! We were lost. Just then, we heard our leader's {3} far away, calling our names. We followed the sound and found the path again. When we arrived, all the other groups were already there. We were thirty minutes {4}. Leo learned a {5} that day: keep your phone away from a compass. And the rest of us learned to keep our eyes on Leo!

blanks.why: point to the north「指向北方」，主詞 its needle 是單數用 points。covers、passes、fires 都不能表示指針的方向。
The distance is about two kilometers.「距離大約兩公里。」voice、letter、office 都不能用公里來量。
hear one's voice「聽到某人的聲音」，後面說在叫我們的名字。letter、office、museum 都不能「聽到」。
thirty minutes late「晚了三十分鐘」，前面說其他組都已經到了。early 不合；strong、serious 不能接在 thirty minutes 後面。
learn a lesson「學到教訓」，冒號後說明教訓內容。half、group、dream 都不能接 learned a ___ 表示教訓。

passages.zh: 上個月在童軍課，我們學習使用指南針。它的指針總是指向北方。領隊帶我們進入森林，給每一組一張地圖。「走到那棵老樟樹，」她說，「距離大約兩公里。」我們這組走了一個小時，卻找不到那棵樹，指南針怪怪的。後來我們發現原因了：Leo 一直把手機拿在指南針旁邊！我們迷路了。就在這時，我們聽到遠處傳來領隊叫我們名字的聲音。我們循著聲音找回了步道。抵達時，其他組都已經到了，我們晚了三十分鐘。Leo 那天學到一個教訓：手機要遠離指南針。而我們其他人則學到：要好好盯著 Leo！

passages.title: 沒有署名的信
passages.text: One morning, I found a {1} in my desk. There was no name on it. It said, "Thank you for helping me last week when I dropped my books on the stairs. You didn't laugh at me, and you helped me pick them up." I tried to remember who it was, but I couldn't. I showed it to my friend Amy. She read it and {2} at the handwriting. "Look, it's very small and neat. It must be Yuki's." Yuki was a quiet girl who had just moved here from Japan. She always spoke in a very soft {3}, and she usually ate lunch alone. At lunchtime, I sat down next to her. Her face turned red when I showed her the letter. "I was too shy to say it, so I wrote it," she said. After school, her bag looked {4}, so I helped her carry it. Since that day, we have {5} our lunch every day.

blanks.why: find a letter「發現一封信」，後面說上面沒有名字、信裡寫了內容。voice、museum、distance 都不能放在書桌裡。
point at …「指著…」：Amy 指著字跡。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。
speak in a soft voice「輕聲細語地說話」。letter、office、distance 都不能接 in a very soft ___。
look heavy「看起來很重」，所以我幫她提。late、early、serious 都不能形容書包重。
share our lunch「一起分享午餐、一起吃午餐」，現在完成式用過去分詞 shared。married、followed、painted 接 our lunch 都不合語意。

passages.zh: 有一天早上，我在書桌裡發現一封信，上面沒有署名。信上寫著：「謝謝你上週我在樓梯上掉了書的時候幫我。你沒有笑我，還幫我把書撿起來。」我努力回想是誰，卻想不起來。我拿給好朋友 Amy 看，她讀完後指著字跡說：「你看，字又小又整齊，一定是 Yuki 寫的。」Yuki 是個剛從日本搬來的安靜女生，她說話總是輕聲細語，通常一個人吃午餐。午餐時間，我坐到她旁邊。我拿出信時，她的臉紅了。「我太害羞，不敢當面說，所以用寫的。」她說。放學後，她的書包看起來很重，我就幫她提。從那天起，我們每天都一起分享午餐。

passages.title: 首爾的第一場雪
passages.text: Last winter, my family went to Seoul for a week. On the third morning, I opened the curtains and shouted. Snow {1} everything: the cars, the trees, and the streets were all white. It was my first time seeing snow! I ran outside without a jacket. My mom shouted in a loud {2}, "Come back and put on your coat!" The snow felt soft and light in my hands, but when my brother and I rolled it into a big ball for a snowman, it became really {3}. In the afternoon, we visited an old palace. Our guide {4} at the roof of a building and said it was six hundred years old. In the evening, we ate hot spicy soup in a small restaurant. I sent snow photos to all my friends in Taiwan. "{5} it will snow in Taipei someday," I said. My brother laughed. "Dream on!"

blanks.why: snow covered everything「雪覆蓋了一切」，後面說全都白了。passed、pointed、fired 都不能表示被雪蓋住。
in a loud voice「大聲地」。letter、office、distance 都不能接 in a loud ___。
become heavy「變重」：滾成大雪球後變得很重，和前面 soft and light（又軟又輕）對比。late、early、serious 不合語意。
point at …「指著…」：導遊指著建築物的屋頂。covered、passed、married 接 at 都不通。
Maybe it will …「也許有一天會…」表示推測。Ago、Else、Already 放在句首都不通。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我們全家去首爾玩了一個星期。第三天早上，我拉開窗簾大叫起來：雪覆蓋了一切，車子、樹和街道全都白了。這是我第一次看到雪！我沒穿外套就衝出去，媽媽大聲喊：「回來穿上大衣！」雪在手裡又軟又輕，但我和弟弟把它滾成大雪球要堆雪人時，它變得好重。下午我們去參觀一座古老的宮殿，導遊指著一棟建築的屋頂說它已經有六百年歷史了。晚上，我們在一家小餐廳喝熱騰騰的辣湯。我把雪景照片傳給台灣所有的朋友。「也許有一天台北也會下雪。」我說。弟弟笑著說：「別作夢了！」

passages.title: 寄宿家庭的餐桌禮儀
passages.text: Last summer, I stayed with a host family in Canada for three weeks. On the first night, we had dinner together. I wanted some salt, but it was at the other end of the table. So I stood up and reached across everyone's plates. The table suddenly became quiet. My host mother smiled kindly and said, "Next time, you can just say, 'Could you {1} the salt, please?'" I felt embarrassed. I learned that in Canada, people don't reach across the table. They also talk in quiet {2} while they eat. Another rule surprised me: never {3} at people with your fork or knife. It is not polite. At the {4} of the three weeks, I knew all the rules, and I even taught them to my little sister on a video call. Before I left, I wrote my host family a long thank-you {5}.

blanks.why: Could you pass the salt?「可以把鹽遞給我嗎？」pass 是「傳遞」。cover、point、fire 接 the salt 都不是請人遞東西。
talk in quiet voices「小聲地說話」。letters、offices、museums 都不能接 in quiet ___。
point at people「用手指（或餐具）指著別人」，不禮貌。cover、bake、marry 接 at people 都不通。
at the end of the three weeks「三週結束時」。power、size、space 不能接 at the ___ of 表示結束時。
a thank-you letter「感謝信」。voice、office、distance 都不能「寫給」寄宿家庭。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我在加拿大的寄宿家庭住了三個星期。第一天晚上，我們一起吃晚餐。我想要加鹽，但鹽在桌子的另一頭，所以我站起來，把手伸過大家的盤子。餐桌突然安靜了。寄宿媽媽親切地笑著說：「下次你可以說：『可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？』」我覺得好尷尬。我學到在加拿大，大家不會把手伸過餐桌拿東西，吃飯時也會小聲說話。還有一條規則讓我很驚訝：絕對不要用叉子或刀子指著別人，那樣很沒禮貌。三週結束時，我已經記住所有規則，甚至還在視訊時教給妹妹。離開前，我寫了一封長長的感謝信給寄宿家庭。

passages.title: 霍爾的移動城堡
passages.text: In the movie Howl's Moving Castle, a young girl named Sophie is turned into an old woman by a witch. She leaves home and finds a strange castle that walks across the hills on four legs. Inside the castle lives a little {1} demon named Calcifer. He burns in the fireplace and gives the castle its power. He also talks in a funny, loud {2} and always complains about being hungry. The castle is huge and very {3}, but Calcifer can make it move. The castle also has a magic door. When you turn a small wheel above it, the door opens to different places, even ones a long {4} away. Sophie starts working as the castle's cleaning lady, and she slowly becomes friends with everyone there. At the {5} of the movie, Sophie's love breaks the bad magic, and everyone finds a new home together.

blanks.why: fire demon「火惡魔」，後面說他在壁爐裡燃燒。letter、voice、museum 都不能「燃燒」。
in a funny, loud voice「用好笑又大聲的聲音」。letter、office、distance 都不能接 talks in a ___。
huge and very heavy「又大又重」，所以需要卡西法才能移動。late、early、serious 都不能形容城堡。
a long distance away「在很遠的地方」。voice、letter、office 都不能接 a long ___ away 表示遠。
at the end of the movie「電影最後」。power、size、space 不能接 at the ___ of the movie。

passages.zh: 在電影《霍爾的移動城堡》裡，一個叫蘇菲的少女被女巫變成了老婆婆。她離開家，發現一座用四隻腳在山丘上行走的奇怪城堡。城堡裡住著一個叫卡西法的小火惡魔，他在壁爐裡燃燒，為城堡提供動力。他說話的聲音又好笑又大聲，還總是抱怨肚子餓。城堡又大又重，但卡西法能讓它移動。城堡還有一扇魔法門，只要轉動門上的小轉盤，門就會通往不同的地方，甚至是很遠很遠的地方。蘇菲開始在城堡裡當清潔婦，慢慢和那裡的每個人成了朋友。電影最後，蘇菲的愛解除了邪惡的魔法，大家一起找到了新的家。

passages.title: 爸爸辦公室的盆栽
passages.text: My dad works in a small {1} with no windows. Last month, he said, "I feel tired all day at work. Maybe it's because there is nothing green there." So I bought him a small plant for his birthday with my own money. He put it on his desk, and he was very happy. Two weeks later, he called me from work. "The plant is dying," he said in a sad {2}. The problem was that it got no sunlight. So now, every Friday, my dad carries the plant home on the MRT. The pot is quite {3}, but he doesn't mind. On weekends, it sits by our sunny window. On Monday morning, he takes it back to work. His coworkers laugh at him, but the plant is healthy now. Its new green leaves {4} the whole pot. "The {5} is not the plant," my dad told me. "It's that you gave it to me."

blanks.why: office「辦公室」，後面說在那裡工作、沒有窗戶。museum、distance、voice 都不是爸爸工作的小房間。
in a sad voice「用難過的聲音」。letter、museum、distance 都不能接 in a sad ___。
heavy「重的」，後面說 but he doesn't mind（但他不介意）。late、early、serious 都不能形容花盆。
cover the whole pot「長滿整個花盆」。pass、point、fire 接 the whole pot 都不能表示葉子長滿。
The point is not …「重點不是…」。letter、museum、distance 放在這裡都不通。

passages.zh: 我爸爸在一間沒有窗戶的小辦公室上班。上個月他說：「我上班整天都覺得好累，也許是因為那裡沒有任何綠色的東西。」所以我用自己的錢買了一盆小盆栽送他當生日禮物。他把它放在桌上，非常開心。兩個星期後，他從公司打電話給我，用難過的聲音說：「盆栽快死了。」問題在於它照不到陽光。所以現在每個星期五，爸爸都搭捷運把盆栽帶回家。花盆滿重的，但他不介意。週末時，它就放在我們家陽光充足的窗邊；星期一早上，他再把它帶回公司。同事都笑他，但盆栽現在很健康，新長的綠葉蓋滿了整個花盆。「重點不是盆栽，」爸爸告訴我，「而是它是你送我的。」
